flags: (sigma,i), sigma in {-1,+1}^d, marked vertex sigma_i e_i
moves: Change marked vertex within the same facet, or flip a nonmarked sign while retaining the vertex.
operator: Unit metric, unit weights; degree2(d-1) graph Laplacian. No fitted phases or truncation.
adapter: B lifts2d vertex amplitudes; m=2^(d-1), D=B^T/m; L=2(HB-BHv/2). W=[B,L_selected_positive_vertices].
next_boundary_test: For the fixed d4 source12-mode closure, determine minimum tetrahedral face-reader covers and rank saturation using actual restrictions, not four independent states per contact by assumption.
nonpromotion: Only d4 has tetrahedral facets. d is not principal electron-shell number;3d is task-relative, not physical capacity. All d2^d original flag modes are retained.
